# Lando schema artifact format

The artifact (`.lando/schema.ts` by default) is the single source of
truth that downstream tools read. It is generated by `lando init` /
`lando generate`, hand-editable for fixups, and committed to version
control alongside `lando.config.ts`.

This document specifies the format. The TypeScript types in
[`types.ts`](./types.ts) are the implementation.

## File shape

```ts
// This file was generated by Lando. Hand-editable for fixups.
// Do not remove the `satisfies LandoSchema` clause: it's load-bearing.

import type { LandoSchema } from 'lando';

export default {
  formatVersion: 1,
  models: { /* ... */ },
  enums: { /* ... */ },
  relations: [ /* ... */ ],
  metadata: { /* ... */ },
} satisfies LandoSchema;
```

The default export must be an object literal. The `satisfies LandoSchema`
clause is required (it's how the parser disambiguates the artifact from
arbitrary TS modules). The header comment is informational and may be
removed without breaking the parse.

## Hand-editing rules

- The default export must be an object literal. Spreads, references,
  and computed keys are rejected. The parser walks the TypeScript AST
  rather than evaluating the file, so we never execute user code at
  load time — every value must be a literal.
- All values inside the literal must themselves be literals: strings,
  finite numbers, booleans, `null`, arrays, or nested object literals.
  Template strings, arithmetic expressions, type assertions other than
  `as const` / `satisfies LandoSchema`, and identifier references are
  rejected.
- Trailing commas are fine. Comments inside the literal are stripped on
  re-emit; they do not survive a `lando generate` round-trip.

## Determinism

`printSchemaModule` is byte-stable for any two structurally equal
schemas. The collection-ordering rules:

| Collection                | Order                                  |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `models`, `enums`         | Alphabetical by key.                   |
| `relations`               | Alphabetical by `name`.                |
| `model.uniques / indexes` | By `name`, fallback to joined fields.  |
| `model.fields`            | Preserved as given (Prisma file order). |
| `enum.values`             | Preserved as given (PG enum order).    |

Order is preserved where it carries meaning (Prisma authors care about
field order; PG enums are physically ordered) and normalised everywhere
else. PRs touching the artifact get clean diffs.

## Format version

The top-level `formatVersion` field is bumped on any *breaking* change
to the shape. Adding a new optional field is non-breaking. Removing a
field, renaming a field, or changing the meaning of an existing field
is breaking.

| Version | Notes                                |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ |
| 1       | Initial format. Shipped in v0.1.     |

## Error codes

`validateSchema` and the parser produce errors with stable codes (see
[`errors.ts`](./errors.ts)):

| Code           | Meaning                                                     |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `L_SCHEMA_001` | Format version mismatch.                                    |
| `L_SCHEMA_002` | Duplicate field name within a model.                        |
| `L_SCHEMA_003` | Reference to an unknown field.                              |
| `L_SCHEMA_004` | Reference to an unknown model.                              |
| `L_SCHEMA_005` | Reference to an unknown enum.                               |
| `L_SCHEMA_006` | Relation field/forward/reverse mismatch.                    |
| `L_SCHEMA_007` | Inheritance discriminator column missing.                   |
| `L_SCHEMA_008` | Inheritance variant invalid (no variants, bad include).     |
| `L_SCHEMA_009` | Polymorphic association with fewer than two variants.       |
| `L_SCHEMA_010` | Association variant references invalid column or model.     |
| `L_SCHEMA_011` | Primary key empty or references unknown fields.             |
| `L_SCHEMA_100` | Parse error on a `.lando/schema.ts` source.                 |
